content:
emily: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread 1762345xxx1 - we agreed on concrete runbook + playbook changes and a single tracking source. Listing owners and next steps here so nothing falls through.

luis: I'll take the recurring-pattern analysis and alerting rules. My plan: build a Grafana alert for KV miss rate spikes and a weekly query that surfaces incident clusters. Will open an issue and a small dashboard PR. ETA: 2026-04-07.

jin: I'll own the triage checklist and the quick-collect commands. Will add a short, copy-pasteable block to the runbook and a minimal script in `infra/tools`. Target PR by Mon.

tara: I'll update the playbook text (when-to-page, who to CC, exact PD escalation steps) and add a 1-line TL;DR at the top for on-call responders. Also will add a 'post-deploy prewarm' step to the deployment checklist. PR by Thu.

emily: Good. Two notes: 1) For paging thresholds propose: sustained p95 latency increase >10% for >8m OR error rate >0.75% for >4m. 2) We need a canonical place to track remediation status (owners, due dates, verification). Proposal: RW incident board + a single GH issue per playbook change.

luis: Agree on tracking. I'll create GH issue RW-INC-4890 for "playbook: recurring-pattern detection + dashboard" and link to it from runbook.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-4890: "playbook - recurring-pattern detection & dashboard". Assigned to luis. Due 2026-04-07.

jin: Example commands I'll include in the runbook (shorter & annotated):
```bash
# runtime health + metrics snapshot
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 50
# model pool state (k/v cache summary)
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
# last 300 runtime logs (json lines)
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -o cat -n 300 --no-pager | jq -r .message
```
I'll also supply a `tools/incident_collect.sh` wrapper that uploads artifacts to the incident bucket.

luis: Observed pattern: several incidents correlate with deploy-time cache flush + cold-starts. Action: add 'cache prewarm' step to playbook and an automated job that warms popular prefixes after deploy. I'll add a short checklist and a runbook link to the deploy docs.

tara: For escalation steps I will add this snippet to the playbook: 
```text
1) Confirm impact metric and window (p95, error_rate).
2) If p95 > threshold -> route traffic to fallback model variant via admin API.
3) If KV miss rate > X% -> trigger cache prewarm job and scale read replicas.
4) After 10m, if impact persists -> page infra-sre and product-ops; if 30m -> exec notify.
```
Include exact PagerDuty escalation names and a runbook link.

emily: Also add a short verification step after fixes: how we validate remediation worked (heatmap of p50/p95 + kv_hit_rate).

jin: I'll ensure the triage checklist includes what to look for in those artifacts (queue_depth, kv_miss_count, model_load_time_ms, gpu_temp) and a short example of quick mitigation commands (scale, routing, restart).

ops-bot: Comment added to RW-INC-4890: "link runbook PRs here + add dashboard URL when ready".

emily: Final owners/due dates for thread: luis - recurring-pattern dashboard & GH issue RW-INC-4890 (due 2026-04-07); jin - triage checklist + tools/incident_collect.sh (PR by Mon 2026-03-30); tara - playbook wording + escalation steps (PR by Thu 2026-04-02). We'll do a 15-min sync Fri 09:00 to review diffs.

luis: Noted, will add the dashboard stub today and tag reviewers.

jin: Starting PR now, tagging @tara and @emily.

tara: Thanks, leaving comments inline once PRs appear. :eyes:

emily: Thanks team, tracking in RW-INC-4890. If anyone hits blockers post here. :rocket:
